<thought>The isotopic envelope shows a dominant monoisotopic peak with a series of M+1, M+2, M+3 … peaks whose relative intensities (≈8 %, 0.5 %, 0.02 % …) match the binomial distribution expected for 13C in a molecule containing about 8 carbon atoms. No other element exhibits such a characteristic multi‑peak pattern with these relative intensities (e.g., Cl, Br, S, Si have distinctive M+2 peaks). Therefore carbon can be definitively identified from the observed pattern.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
